structural_change: S81U-SEQ (S81-DV p4f..p4i, owner-approved DV plan): L0 link leaf of dsdv_seq_host: host lane port + host ingest (dsfd_host_native, unchanged) + host write decode (dsfd_host_sd STATIC) + svc / kit ports + regional status fold + one rung hop each way; flop-first / flop-last pins, die hold budget. S81U-SEQ3 (gate 8940e10e9 clock_rule FAIL: 24,085 sinks on one root, TT ins 306.7): the host ingest's own Gray-FIFO clock domains (dsfd_host_native clk_h / clk_i, ot_link_afifo crossings) get their own CTS roots ck_ih / ck_ic (same stream clock, related phase-0 roots, ordinary STA across them), as the S81 host tile dsfd_host_c DSFD_HOST_PQ_BOOT (ck_ingest roots); estimated roots ~8.8k / ~10.3k / ~5.5k sinks, each < 15k. A two-leaf split cannot reach < 15k: dsfd_host_native alone is ~19.2k flops (u_hx 16 x 514 + u_ox 16 x 289 + engine). Ingest engine APIPE 2 -> 4 (26-level ap1_local -> ap_raddr stage registered; ROWS / IKEY +1 bubble edge a row, RAW unchanged); pin-flop payloads off the reset net (891 loads). S81U-SEQ4 (gate4 df8031f2c WARN: 3 roots max 9,551 sinks, TT ins 239.9 / sp 33.2; reg->reg -69.7 ps at u_eng.ap1_rbase = base + stk * stride in one stage): ingest APIPE 5 (stack x stride partial products formed in stage A0, stage A1 a four-operand add; same values / bubble edges as APIPE 4). Reset WARNs u_hi.u_rsc / u_rsi reset_pipe 472 / 438 loads are inside the reused ot_rom_host_ingest (shared with closed dsfd_host views; not edited): below the 8,000 refuse bound, reset in->reg slack +409 ps. RTL-BUILD-S81 10-18 (bind5 residual (b)/(c)): two svc halves -- s_jd/s_hc/st_rg/s_hw become per-half s_jd_w/_e (merged in-leaf: done when both halves reported, same pin->jd_o edges), s_hw_w/_e + s_hc_w/_e (dsfd_host_sd NS 2 HALF 1: sector -> PC-owner half, markers to both), st_rg_w/_e (fault OR, live AND); _w set on the E face, _e set on the S face (E 449 -> 454 bits, S 552 -> 857 bits = 3.4/um).
